title: Sign-in attempt telemetry in Application Insights for partners

da.title: Sign-in attempt telemetry in Application Insights for partners
da.summary: If a telemetry key for an environment has been specified in the Business Central administration center, the server will emit telemetry about sign-in attempts (successful or failed) to Application Insights
da.details:
### Business value

Partners can set up and use Application Insights to monitor when users experience sign-in issues (for example, because of missing permissions) and proactively help their customers without the need to contact Microsoft support.

### Feature details

The Business Central server will emit telemetry about sign-in attempts (successful or failed). For failed attempts, the reason will be logged in the message as well. After a successful authorization to Business Central, the server will also emit telemetry about the Open Company operation (successful or failed). For failed authorization to a company, the reason will also be logged in the message.

### See also

Analyzing Authorization Trace Telemetry (docs)
